summary: No advisory committee was convened for the Jakafi (ruxolitinib) NDA 202192 approval. The FDA Summary Review and medical review both state that an Oncology Drugs Advisory Committee meeting was not planned, because the benefits in spleen volume reduction and symptom control were evident from two adequate and well-controlled trials and the adverse reactions appeared manageable. With no committee meeting, there were no AdComm-driven changes to the approval.
